name: Observability Sweep
description: Periodic health sweep through the canonical read-only Admin v1 logs contract plus the debug pipeline. Partial evidence is never treated as healthy; a real anomaly opens one evidence-backed work item and a healthy sweep opens none.

sampleTasks.title: Sweep the system, distinguish complete from partial evidence, and open a bug only for a real anomaly
sampleTasks.prompt: Run the observability skill from the repository root. First ACK the skill. Call `npx tsx scripts/debug/admin-observability.ts capabilities`, then query `logs --target-kind=service --target-id=prismer-cloud --since=15m --purpose=periodic-apc-observability-sweep --completeness=require-complete`. For sandbox or daemon evidence, first call `cloud admin log-targets --kind sandbox|daemon --purpose <reason>` and use the returned logical id; never guess a Pod, namespace, or selector. This client must use only canonical Admin v1 read endpoints through the daemon-held credential. Exit 3 from the strict script or exit 2 from `cloud admin logs` means the confidence boundary is partial and must never be reported healthy. SLS offset continuation is best-effort and never proves stable completeness. Never pass or print an API key, run `env`/`printenv`, enable shell tracing, or persist Authorization data. Return an opaque nextCursor unchanged as `--cursor=<opaque>`; never parse or synthesize it. attemptedSourceTiers reports attempts only; availableSourceTiers reports available evidence. In production require-complete, retained evidence must be available, stable, complete, untruncated, and non-duplicating, with productionRetainedRequirement.satisfied=true. Then run `scripts/debug/inventory.ts`, persist the current output under `.e2e-tmp/apc/observability/`, and explicitly adjudicate pods, workspaces, tasks, errors, and daemon. Drill into any suspect with snapshot/bundle/logs. Cite current repo-relative evidence lines for every signal face. Open a `work_item` only for an evidence-backed anomaly and read the task back; otherwise report healthy and open no task. The final report must include contractDigest, principal, requestId, attemptedSourceTiers, availableSourceTiers, per-source outcomes, coverage, partial/truncated, production retained confidence gate, redaction ruleset, evidenceHash, and an explicit confidence boundary.
expectedArtifacts: canonical capabilities and logs-query receipts with contract/principal/request/source/coverage/redaction/evidence metadata
five keyed SIGNAL-pods/workspaces/tasks/errors/daemon lines, each with a current repo-relative citation or explicit N/A reason
drill-down side-effect slice for every suspect
explicit anomaly, healthy, or partial-evidence verdict grounded in side effects
anomaly path: a read-back work_item with evidence; healthy path: explicit no-task statement

acceptanceCriteria.label: used canonical Admin v1 discovery and logs query
reports completeness and the confidence boundary
every signal face was adjudicated from current evidence or explicit N/A
made an explicit anomaly, healthy, or partial-evidence decision
grounded the verdict in side effects
does not fabricate a bug on a healthy sweep
anomaly path creates a work item with evidence

humanApprovalRequiredFor: test/prod sweeps require platform-held admin credentials that are never injected into a coding-agent workdir or command line
